chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham ibnoub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Hamza, who said: 'I took this supplication from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him), and Abu Ja'far used to call it 'The Comprehensive'.'

In the Name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. I testify that there is no god except Allah, Alone, there being no associate for Him. And I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger. I believe in Allah and in all of His Messengers, and in all of what He revealed with upon all of the Messengers, and that the Promise of Allah is True, and His Meeting is True, and Allah Spoke the Truth and the Mursil Prophets delivered (the Message).

And the Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, and Glory be to Allah every time something Glorifies Allah, and just as Allah Loves that He be Glorified. And the Praise is for Allah every time something praises Him, and just as He Loves that He be Praised. And there is no god except Allah every time something Extols the Oneness of Allah, and just as Allah Loves that He be Extolled. And Allah is the Greatest, every time something exclaims the Greatness of Allah and just as Allah Loves that His Greatness be exclaimed.

O Allah! I ask You for the opening of the goodness, and for its completion, and for its pleasures, and its benefits, and its Blessings, and what my knowledge reaches it, and what my memory falls short of its counting. O Allah! Draw closer to me the causes for its recognition, and Open its doors for me, and Overwhelm me with the Blessings of Your Mercy, and Bestow upon me the infallibility from the decline from Your Religion.

And Purify my heart from the doubts, and do not Let my heart be pre-occupied with my world and my immediate life from the deferred Rewards of my Hereafter, and Pre-occupy my heart with the preservation of what is not Acceptable from me from being ignorant of it, and Humble my tongue for every goodness, and Purify my heart from the showing off, and do not Cause it (showing off) to flow in my joints, and Make my deeds to be sincerely for You.

O Allah! I seek Refuge with You from the evil and the varieties of the immoralities, all of them, its apparent ones and its hidden ones, and its neglectful ones, and the entirety of what the Pelted Satan intends me with, and what the obstinate ruling authorities intend me with from what his knowledge encompasses, and You are Able upon Exchanging it from me.

O Allah! I seek Refuge with You from the ways of the Jinn and the human beings, and their furies, and their noisy disputes, and their plots, and facing the mischief from the Jinn and the human beings and that they would waver me from my Religion so they would spoil my Hereafter upon me, and that would happen to be harmful upon me during my life-time, or they would present an affliction to hit me from them, there neither being any strength for me with it nor patience for me upon bearing it.

Therefore, do not Try me, O my God, with its sizes so that would prevent me from remembering You and pre-occupy me from worshipping You. You are the Rescuer, the Defender, the Repeller, the Saver from all of that. I ask You, O Allah, for the ease in my living for what remains of my life-time, I can strengthen by being upon Your obedience, and reach Your Pleasure by it, and by it I can come to the House of (eternal) living tomorrow.

And do not Grace me with such a sustenance which would cause me to transgress, and nor Try me with poverty which I would be miserable with, being constrained upon me. Give me an abundant share in my Hereafter, and a capacious living, welcoming, pleasant in my world, and do not Make the world to be a prison upon me, nor Making its separation upon me to be a grief. Rescue me from its strife and Make my deeds therein to be Acceptable, and my striving in it to be grateful.

O Allah! And the one who intends evil with me, Return it to him with the like of it, and the one who plots against me therein, so Plot (against) him, and Exchange from me its worries from entering upon me, and Plan against the one who plans against me, for You are the Best of the planners, and Blind from me the eyes of the disbelievers, and the oppressors, and the arrogant ones, and the envious ones.

O Allah! And Send down the tranquillity upon me, from You, and Clothe me with Your Fortified Shield, and Protect me with Your Defensive Veil, and Wrap me with Your goodly beneficial health, and Ratify my words and my deeds, and Bless for me regarding my children, and my family, and my wealth.

O Allah! Whatever I have sent forward, and whatever I have delayed, and whatever I neglected, and whatever I deliberated, and whatever I slackened, and whatever I (did) publicly, and whatever I (did) privately, so Forgive it for me, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones!

key_terms.الْمُرْسَلُونَ: The Mursil Prophets (those sent with new laws)

ai.seo_question: What is the comprehensive supplication known as Al-Jami in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this supplication is revered as 'Al-Jami' due to its comprehensive scope, encapsulating the entire spectrum of human spiritual and material needs within a single narrative. It reflects the Imams' pedagogical approach by structuring the prayer from foundational creed (Tawhid and Risalah) to practical daily concerns, ensuring the supplicant remains anchored in divine awareness amidst worldly trials. This structure underscores the Shia emphasis on integrating deep theological conviction with everyday life, making it a cornerstone for both individual devotion and communal recitation.
